page_title: BOU 2-1 MCI | Bournemouth v Manchester City 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
90+5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+4' A cross into the box from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
90+4' Oh, what a chance! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the left post.

90+4' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
90+4' Phil Foden (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Phil Foden (Manchester City). Manchester City win a corner.
90+3' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+3' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+1' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) sees a yellow card from Michael Oliver after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' That's the end of the game for Marcus Tavernier, who is replaced by Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth).
90' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

90' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Mark Travers, who tips the ball around the post. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
87' It looks like Enes Unal (Bournemouth) saw red with that tackle. Michael Oliver won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Manchester City are awarded the free kick.
85' Substitution. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) has come on for Ilkay Gundogan.

82' 2 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Ilkay Gundogan is pounced on by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City). His close-range header flashes past Mark Travers and into the top left corner. 2:1.
82' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes it short.

82' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
80' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Travers pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
79' David Brooks (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
78' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Justin Kluivert will be replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is replacing Evanilson.
77' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
75' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
73' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Rico Lewis (Manchester City) replaces Nathan Ake.
73' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) dribbles into the box, but Ederson is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
71' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Kyle Walker (Manchester City) for a tough tackle.
70' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Ederson easily deals with the threat.
68' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
68' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
66' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) replacing Ryan Christie.
64' 2 - 0 Evanilson (Bournemouth) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish!
64' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
63' The free kick is taken by Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City), but ball is cleared.

63' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Oliver stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester City.
61' The corner by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

60' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
57' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester City.
54' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth). A free kick to Manchester City.
51' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post.
50' Flag goes up against Evanilson (Bournemouth) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
48' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

47' A loose ball is pounced on by Evanilson (Bournemouth) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Ederson is alert and makes a comfortable save. Bournemouth get a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Michael Oliver has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Manchester City.
41' The linesman raises his flag. Evanilson (Bournemouth) is adjudged offside.
38' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
37' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick.
34' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
33' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
30' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post.
29' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
29' Phil Foden (Manchester City) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Manchester City earn a corner.
29' The resulting corner, taken by Phil Foden (Manchester City), comes to nothing.
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
24' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
23' The game is interrupted as Evanilson (Bournemouth) is flagged offside.
22' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick is awarded to Manchester City.
19' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

18' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
14' A clever short pass gives Nathan Ake (Manchester City) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
13' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.

9' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
8' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Today's referee Michael Oliver rightly decides to book Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) for his harsh tackle.
4' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

4' The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.

2' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Ederson pulls off a comfortable save.
2' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
